column4: Guards against a repeated order. The payment gateway can return the customer to the confirmation view more than once, and each return would send another purchase. Set a flag in session storage keyed on the order ID, check it before sending, and stop the rule when the flag is already there. Without this, refreshing the confirmation page doubles the order.

column4: Joins the cart array into a product string. One entry per product, comma separated, in the order the cart shows them. A single entry holding several IDs reports as one product that does not exist in the catalogue, which is the most common product string fault and it looks like a data problem rather than a code problem.

column3: Deciding whether a search was null
column4: Sets the null search event only when the result count is exactly zero. A count that arrives as an empty string, or as the text "0", or as undefined, is not zero, and each of the three fails differently. Compare against a number after an explicit conversion.
